title: People Come Back for the Hello, Not the Latte

scenes.say: Your coffee isn't why they come back. The hello is.
A great latte matters. But plenty of cafes make a great latte. Only yours knows Maria's name.

scenes.speaker: Maria
scenes.say: They remembered my name. And my dog's name.

props.name: Maria
props.quote: They know my name. *And my dog's.*

scenes.say: So learn five regulars' names this week. The coffee keeps them happy. The hello brings them back. Agree?
